# {{PROJECT_NAME}} Process Register

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

The process register is the complete Layer 2 operational record for tailored use of the 40 PMI processes. It is not a substitute for process evidence and is not the default PM view.


## Human-Facing Process View

Generate this compact view from the complete table when the PM asks about process status. Do not copy all 40 processes into the default response.

| Area | Process or activity | Status | What matters | Next action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {{AREA}} | {{HUMAN_PROCESS_NAME}} | Done / In progress / Attention required / Waiting for your decision | {{MATERIAL_POINT}} | {{NEXT_ACTION_OR_NONE}} |

Include only:

- active processes;
- completed processes that matter to the current update;
- processes requiring attention; and
- processes waiting for a PM decision.

Use human-readable names. Keep process IDs, run links, and stage mechanics in the complete control table and run records.

## Presentation Rules

- The complete table is Layer 2 operational control.
- The human-facing process view is a generated view, not a second source of truth.
- Translate internal states into Done, In progress, Attention required, Waiting for your decision, or Not yet assessed.
- Do not show the full process register unless the user asks for it or needs audit-level detail.

## State Rules

Use `references/process-execution-rules.md`. Recurring processes remain `Current` with a next trigger. A missing PM response produces `Governance pending`, not completion.
